title: boundedConstructible_shift_single
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor product, R a ring object in A-valued pro-etale sheaves, and M a constructible internal R-module. For every integer n, singleFunctor(M,0) shifted by n is bounded constructible in the exact upstream predicate. No commutativity hypothesis on R is needed.

source.place: Zero twist and degree-zero realization; elementary shifted-single calculation needed for the Poincare Tate target.

proof.text: Use the shifted-single isomorphism to move the module to degree -n. The standard t-structure places this object both in degrees at least and at most -n. Homology in degree -n is M by singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso; all other homology objects vanish. Reuse constructible_of_iso and constructible_of_isZero from Sheaf.UpstreamExtra.WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.ProEtaleModule.DerivedCategory through a proof-only import all, since those helpers are private. The interval [-n,-n] and these constructibility proofs satisfy mem_boundedConstructible_iff. No duplicate constructibility or local finite presentation helper is declared.

theorem boundedConstructible_shift_single
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) R)
    (hM : IsConstructibleModuleObject R M) (n : ℤ) :
    boundedConstructible R
      ((shiftFunctor _ n).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
